description: REEF3D::SEASTATE time series of boundary spectra at many locations (A 711 3, nonstationary SWAN file seastate-boundary.spc): 3 locations, 4 hourly records with changing Hs, Tp and direction, spectra on the x- and y- sides from the two nearest locations (inverse distance), zero gradient at y+, model start 00:30 after the first record (A 780), linear in time; 20 x 10 cells of 1 km, depth 30 m, 2 h. Validation in Dropbox SEASTATE/validation/15-16.
covers: seastate_implicit boundary_sides on x- and y-
